rules.note: GRANTS AN APPLICATION ACCESS TO YOUR ACCOUNT without you reading the screen. The engine refuses this kind unless confirmGrantsAccess is true. Scope it to one host and one app; never point it at a shared IdP domain like accounts.google.com, where it would blanket-approve every app that asks.
